_comment: Generic strategy-consumption contract vocabulary. Reference/documentation only -- no strategy YAML in this repository declares this block yet, and this file does not create or imply one. A strategy that later wants to consume multi-timeframe-market-context would add a `multi_timeframe_context:` block shaped like this to its own strategy YAML, under a separately versioned, explicitly authorized change.
default_mode_rationale: An OBSERVE_ONLY binding may be recorded as metadata on a strategy's report/ticket but must never affect that strategy's decision, direction, entry, SL, TP, risk, or size (see AG_UNIVERSAL_MULTI_TIMEFRAME_OPERATIONAL_STATUS 'Strategy preservation' evidence). Promoting a field to REQUIRED/SCORE_ONLY/EXPECTED_CONFLICT requires evidence of it improving or legitimately changing that strategy's own expectancy, gathered while it was OBSERVE_ONLY, plus an explicit versioned strategy change and governance review -- never as a side effect of installing or extending this skill.
